meta.title: Devlog: October 18, 2026 - October 25, 2026
meta.description: shipped clearer publishing, editing, and finished-output workflows while refining due or die’s trial messaging.

bullets.text: refined the in-progress paywall and onboarding to clearly explain eligible free trials, renewal terms, and store confirmation before purchase.
updated trial calls to action so they accurately reflect whether a plan is eligible, available, and not a lifetime purchase.

summary.text: i'm tightening up the subscription flow so it says what it means before anyone gets sent to the store. small copy changes, fewer chances for a surprise plot twist.

bullets.text: shipped finished-video uploads with review, editing, playback preparation, and publishing support while preserving the original video’s framing and audio.
added relative clip-length choices to video assembly so creators can guide pacing with short, medium, long, or unrestricted slots without automatic trimming.
added safer deletion flows for completed videos and slideshows, with clear confirmations and protection for source media and other finished outputs.
expanded slideshow publishing with optional trending audio for converted videos and platform-specific posting controls.
improved publishing checks for required post copy and platform-specific title requirements before a batch is prepared.

summary.text: this week was mostly about making finished work easier to bring in, shape, publish, and clean up afterward. the editor has more room for pacing and audio now, which is a much nicer problem to have than losing track of a render.
